bd_police_monthly_ocr.name: Bangladesh Crime Statistics: OCR-Processed and Structured Dataset from Official Police Reports (v1)
bd_police_monthly_ocr.publisher: Md Shafikul Islam, Noushin Sharmin Tonima, A.S.S.M. Nazmul Arefin (Daffodil International University), Mendeley Data, doi:10.17632/zt72g9wxh8.1; underlying data: Bangladesh Police monthly crime statistics (police.gov.bd)
bd_police_monthly_ocr.years: monthly, 25 months between Jan 2021 and Sep 2025 (see notes)
bd_police_monthly_ocr.notes: Murder cases per month by police unit, OCR'd by the dataset authors from the scanned police PDFs. Quality check run here: for each month, unit values must add up to the table's own Total row. Only the 25 months that pass were kept: Jan-Jul 2021 except Aug, Dec 2021, Jan/Feb/May/Jul 2022, Jan-Jul 2023, Jan/Feb/Oct 2024, Jun/Jul/Sep 2025 (exact list: Apr-21, Apr-23, Dec-21, Feb-21, Feb-22, Feb-23, Feb-24, Jan-21, Jan-22, Jan-23, Jan-24, Jul-21, Jul-22, Jul-23, Jul-25, Jun-21, Jun-23, Jun-25, Mar-21, Mar-23, May-21, May-22, May-23, Oct-24, Sep-25). The other 31 months failed the check (OCR errors such as 'I', 'S', 'N/A', blanks, sum mismatches) and were left out; they remain in raw/. The file has two different blocks both labelled Jul-24 and no Jun-24; both were left out. Police ranges cover the division of the same name minus the metropolitan police areas inside it, so they are not given a division shape.

bd_metro_panel.name: Trends, patterns and projection of crime in metropolitan Bangladesh, 2010-2024 (metro_panel.csv)
bd_metro_panel.publisher: Md Abu Bakkar Siddik, Mendeley Data, doi:10.17632/6gcxzcm8kd.1 (compiled from metropolitan police unit tables)
bd_metro_panel.years: 2010-2018, 2020-2024 (gaps by city; Gazipur and Rangpur only recent years)
bd_metro_panel.notes: Annual murder case counts ('cases', crime_category 'Murder'). The deposit's 'rate' column was not kept because it uses the author's interpolated population, not a published rate.

problems: Official site police.gov.bd and bbs.gov.bd could not be reached from this environment (connection failed / HTTP 503; WebFetch blocked by robots.txt; Wayback Machine not reachable). data.gov.bd's 'Crime Statistics' entry only links to the police website. Both datasets used are academic re-publications on Mendeley Data (CC BY 4.0). OCR quality problems in the monthly dataset are described above.
